title: 第77章 搬家，退房
content_zh:
第77章 搬家，退房-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

上一章

存书签

下一章

赵素梅看着他，轻轻叹了口气。

她知道，林国强不是心硬。

是被伤透了。

分家的时候，林美玲帮他说了句话，他一直记着，逢年过节从不落下。

可林美丽呢？

从始至终，没替他说过一个字。

反而嫌他多管闲事。

这样的人，林国强能给她好脸才怪。

“行了，不说她了。”林国强夹了块肉给林静，“吃饭。”

林静捧着碗，奶声奶气地问：“爹，小姑今天带的鸡蛋糕好吃，她啥时候还来？”

“她不来了。”

“为啥呀？”

林国强没回答。

赵素梅给林静擦了擦嘴：“快吃饭，凉了就不好吃了。”

林静乖乖低头扒饭。

院子里安静下来，只有碗筷碰撞的声音。

月亮爬上墙头，照得院子亮堂堂的。

林国强吃完饭，坐在门口抽了根烟。

他想起林美丽今天来的样子。

碎花连衣裙，烫卷的头发，白塑料凉鞋。

强撑着一脸笑，说王超对她好。

他不信。

前世的记忆摆在那儿，由不得他不信。

但他不打算再管了。

该说的说了，该拦的拦了。

人家非要往火坑里跳，他还能绑着不成？

一根烟抽完，他把烟头摁灭。

起身，回屋。

六月十六，交房的日子。

林国强一大早就去了马德福那里，把钥匙往桌上一放。

“马主任，房子腾干净了，你验收。”

马德福坐在办公桌后面，茶缸子端在半空，愣了好几秒。

“真不租了？”

“不租了。”

“你那新店……”

“在镇南头，三间门面，后院三间瓦房，自己的。”

林国强说完，转身走了。

马德福端着茶缸子，半天没喝。

镇南头那房子他知道，老周的。

前几天听说卖出去了，没想到买家是林国强。

三千五。

说买就买了。

他忽然有点后悔。

当初要是不涨那二十块房租，这租户是不是还能留？

Zhao Sumei looked at him and sighed softly.

She knew that Lin Guoqiang was not hard-hearted.

It was broken.

When they separated, Lin Meiling said something to him, and he always remembered it, never falling behind during the holidays.

But what about Lin Meili?

From beginning to end, I never said a word for him.

Instead, he thought he was nosy.

It's strange that Lin Guoqiang can give her such a good face.

"Okay, let's not talk about her anymore." Lin Guoqiang took a piece of meat to Lin Jing and said, "Eat."

Lin Jing held the bowl and asked in a sweet voice, "Dad, the chicken cakes my sister-in-law brought today are delicious. When will she come again?"

"She's not coming."

"Why?"

Lin Guoqiang did not answer.

Zhao Sumei wiped Lin Jing's mouth: "Eat quickly, it won't taste good when it's cold."

Lin Jing obediently lowered her head to eat.

The courtyard became quiet, with only the sound of clinking bowls and chopsticks.

The moon climbed up the wall and illuminated the yard.

After Lin Guoqiang finished his meal, he sat at the door and smoked a cigarette.

He thought of Lin Meili's appearance today.

Floral dress, permed hair, white plastic sandals.

She forced a smile on her face and said that Wang Chao was good to her.

He didn't believe it.

The memories of his past life were there, he couldn't help but not believe them.

But he wasn't going to care anymore.

What should be said has been said, and what should be stopped has been stopped.

If someone insists on jumping into the fire pit, can he still tie him up?

After smoking a cigarette, he put out the cigarette butt.

Get up and go back to the house.

June 16th is the day of handover.

Lin Guoqiang went to Ma Defu's place early in the morning and put the key on the table.

"Director Ma, the house has been vacated. Please accept it."

Ma Defu sat behind his desk, holding the teapot in the air, and was stunned for several seconds.

"You really don't want to rent anymore?"

"No more renting."

"Your new store..."

"At the south end of the town, there are three facades and three tile-roofed houses in the backyard. It's my own."

After Lin Guoqiang finished speaking, he turned around and left.

Ma Defu held the teapot and didn't drink for a long time.

He knew that house at the south end of the town, it belonged to Lao Zhou.

I heard it was sold a few days ago, but I didn't expect the buyer to be Lin Guoqiang.

Three thousand and five.

I bought it when I said I would.

He suddenly regretted it.

If the rent hadn't been increased by 20 yuan, would this tenant still be able to stay?
